instruction: I have requested expense details from my coworkers via email for our recent company trip. Please extract relevant information from them and save it in "~/documents/work/expense_reimbursements.csv". The file already has the headers. Fill in the rest.
notes: Task is a data-extraction/file-update task with no answer. Supervisor's coworkers replied to her expense-details request by email; the model treats the reply thread as a single thread entity found via show_inbox_threads (query 'expense') and read via show_thread, which makes (expenses-known) true. If replies are spread across several threads, show_thread is repeated per thread at runtime. The CSV file already has headers, so show_file is required before update_file so the existing header line is preserved and rows 'first_name,flight,accommodation,meals' are appended. update_file's content object is composed at runtime; the goal demands exactly one file update to the given path. supervisor-complete-task carries the file/content records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; it has no answer argument.
